name: Cart Conversion Boost
author: cartconversionboost

sections.description:
Cart Conversion Boost helps you increase your checkout conversion rate by seamlessly passing customer name and email from your Thrive Themes (Thrive Architect & Thrive Leads) opt-in forms into your ThriveCart checkout pages *.

Take the customer details before they get to the shopping cart, so you can follow up, and convert more to completed sale, in case of cart abandonment.

When a visitor signs up through your Thrive Themes opt-in form, this plugin ensures their name and email address are automatically pre-filled on the ThriveCart payment page — reducing friction and improving the user experience.

Disclaimer – Cart Conversion Boost is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ThriveThemes or ThriveCart.

Video Overview

Watch how Cart Conversion Boost works in under 2 minutes:

Screenshots

  1. The plugin interface screenshot-1.jpg
  2. Paste your CartConversionBoost URL into your ThriveThemes optin form as the “Target URL”. Make sure to tick/check the “Send form values” field.
  3. Customer enters their name and email in the pre-sale opt-in
  4. Your ThriveCart checkout is automatically pre-filled with their name and email already, helping conversion to sale. No repeated typing.

🚀 Key Benefits

  • Improve conversion rates
  • Reduced cart abandonment
  • Capture the lead before the payment page
  • Pre-fill ThriveCart checkout fields automatically
  • Reduce friction during checkout – Faster checkout experience
  • Simple setup inside WordPress admin
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • NoCode interface

A smoother checkout experience often leads to higher completion rates and better user experience.

Why This Matters

Every extra step in a checkout process increases the chance that a customer abandons their purchase.

When customers must re-enter information they already provided, it introduces:

Friction
Delay
Drop-off risk

Cart Conversion Boost removes this friction by seamlessly connecting your Thrive Themes opt-in form and ThriveCart checkout flow.

🔗 How It Works

  1. A user completes a ThriveThemes opt-in form which captures their name and email, and sends their details to your 3rd-party email provider,
  2. The CartConversionBoost plugin securely passes the name and email into the correct format for ThriveCart
  3. The user is redirected to your ThriveCart product checkout page
  4. ThriveCart checkout fields are automatically pre-filled
  5. Customer completes purchase faster

No complex setup, integrations or third-party connectors required.

  • Not affiliated with or provided by ThriveThemes or ThriveCart. This is a 3rd-party bridging tool. Thrive Themes and ThriveCart are trademarks of their respective owners. Cart Conversion Boost is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Thrive Themes or ThriveCart.

Key Features

  • Automatically pass name and email to ThriveCart
  • Works with Thrive Themes opt-in forms
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No external dependencies (just ThriveThemes and ThriveCart)
  • No tracking or analytics
  • Simple setup
  • Secure – no data is stored
  • GDPR-friendly approach

Use Cases

Cart Conversion Boost is useful for:

Free-plus-shipping offers
Course creators
Digital product sellers
Membership sites
Service providers
Marketing funnels
Lead magnet funnels

Any funnel using Thrive opt-ins followed by ThriveCart checkout can benefit.

Requirements

  • WordPress
  • Thrive Themes (or Thrive Leads)
  • ThriveCart account (Basic or Pro)

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Additional Notes

If you are using the Pro version of Cart Conversion Boost, please deactivate and delete it before activating this free version to avoid conflicts.
sections.installation:
See the installation video at https://cartconversionboost.com/how-to-use-thrive-conversion-boost-plugin/

  1. Install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Cart Conversion Boost plugin settings page in your admin dashboard.
  4. Configure your ThriveCart checkout URL and parameters. See included video for specific installation details
  5. Copy and paste your CartConversionBoost URL into your ThriveThemes form ‘Target URL’ (the page the optin form sends the user to, after completing the optin form)
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require ThriveCart?

Yes. This plugin is designed specifically to work with ThriveCart checkout pages.

What data is passed to ThriveCart?

Currently, the plugin supports passing:

  • Name
  • Email address

Is this compatible with all opt-in forms?

The plugin is specifically designed to work with ThriveThemes (Thrive Architect, Thrive Leads), to pass into ThriveCart. Compatibility with any other forms may depend on how your forms handle redirects. If you want us to add your optin form platform to this plugin, get contact us to request this.

Can I use this with the Pro version?

You use this free version OR the Pro version. One or the other. If the Pro version is active, the free version will automatically deactivate to prevent conflicts. The Pro version allows you to use Cart Conversion Boost for an unlimited number of products, so you can scale and grow your revenue.

Does this store user data?

No sensitive data is stored long-term. The plugin simply passes data through the URL for pre-filling checkout fields.

Does this require coding?

No. Setup is designed to be simple and user-friendly. Just copy and paste your URL as shown in the easy-to-follow instructions.

Disclaimer

Cart Conversion Boost is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Thrive Themes or ThriveCart.
